title: Part III (Articles 12–35) is the Magna Carta of India, guaranteeing six categories of Fundamental Rights

content.overview: Part III (Articles 12–35) is the Magna Carta of India, guaranteeing six categories of Fundamental Rights. Enforceable against the State under Article 12, protected by judicial review under Article 13, and guaranteed by the constitutional remedy under Article 32. Non-suspendable regarding Articles 20 and 21.
